title: Black October: a security filter switched off by a name
summary: Colin McNamara on bypassing AI policy via headers and the cost of coordinated disclosure.

chapters.title: Building the defense in depth lab

learn: Finding vulnerabilities and fixing them has scaled with compute access to GPUs and Frontier APIs.
When an endpoint picker and a filter share a name, a single header can skip policy. The fix is simple: don't give them the same name.
GitHub is now rate-limiting the vulnerability reports, creating a platform barrier between consumers and maintainers.
Writing the fixes took way less time than the entire process of coordinating a disclosure.
